limits: Changed local choices demonstrate sensitivity of the implemented picker to row normalization on these saved prefixes. They do not measure resulting native return, establish a causal explanation of failure, or qualify any model.
The protocol explicitly used exact computed-score ties, so this is a disclosed numerical/design limitation of that recipe rather than retroactive removal of its unfavorable results.
Any altered controller requires a prospective fresh-seed comparison; these64 evaluation seeds are exposed.
normalization: raw float64 p / p.sum(axis=1, keepdims=True), followed by the identical unseen-uniform and current-visible overrides; finite floating arithmetic, not an assertion of exactly representable unit row sums
pair_choice: Same exact lexicographic float64 computed-score argmax; no epsilon is used to choose actions. The 1e-7 threshold only describes gaps after selection.
scope: Posthoc saved-score diagnostic, not a new policy evaluation or a continuation criterion
trajectory_policy: Every step is independently inspected at its actual saved public prefix. Bookkeeping advances using the actual action and observation only; proposed normalized choices are never executed or fed back.
